fdroid:adb.captain.summary: Run ADB commands on your phone. No root, no PC — via Shizuku.
fdroid:adb.captain.description:
ADB Captain runs ADB commands right on your phone. No computer, no root - it works through Shizuku.
What's inside:
- Terminal. pm, am, dumpsys, settings, input - anything adb shell takes. Several sessions at once, each with its own output and its own command still running. Autocomplete pulls from your command history, history is grouped by how recent it is, and you can pin the commands you use most.
- Debugging workspace. One tab for the job: a bug report ZIP, a timed session that records what you did and buffers the log while you reproduce a crash, saved macros for chains of commands, and crash logs grouped per app with the full stack trace.
- Apps. Every installed package in one list, user and system apps separated. Each one gets a plain safety rating, so you know what's safe to disable or remove. An inspector shows activities, services, receivers and providers with the permissions they need, and an intent launcher lets you build and fire an intent by hand.
- Processes. The real table with PID, parent, user and memory, searchable, with force-stop on any row.
- Devices. Model, Android version, battery, connection status. Reboot and screenshots from the same screen.
- Wireless ADB. Pair and connect to any device over Wi-Fi, then run shell commands on it. Saved devices, one-tap reconnect, optional auto-reconnect.
- Logcat. Live system log, filterable by level and text. Follow whatever app is in the front, save exactly what you see to a file, and share it as Markdown for a bug report.
- Sideload and tools. Install an APK from storage, record the screen, flip Wi-Fi, Bluetooth or airplane mode, type text, open links.
- Appearance. Material 3 Expressive, with light or dark theme, five accent palettes, or follow the system colors with Material You.
AGPL-3.0. No ads, no analytics, no accounts.

fdroid:io.github.strongsand.lshell.name: L-Shell Orbit
fdroid:io.github.strongsand.lshell.summary: Local monitoring and diagnostics for compatible Starlink equipment
fdroid:io.github.strongsand.lshell.description:
L-Shell Orbit is an independent, unofficial app for monitoring and diagnosing compatible Starlink terminals and routers over the local network.
Follow connection state, traffic, latency, packet loss, signal, power, obstruction and alerts using the data exposed by the equipment. Explore history and daily, weekly and monthly reports, export information, and manually back up and restore local data.
On compatible routers, also view reported PoE input voltage associated with the current terminal. This is not a measurement of current or cable-output voltage.
Arrange home screen cards, explore charts and follow metrics through widgets and notifications. Run normal and extreme speed tests or configure scheduled and smart tests. Android controls background execution and may delay these tests.
L-Shell Beacon is an optional collector that can retain Dishy history while the phone is away and synchronize it on the same network. Power Monitor displays electrical readings received from a compatible HTTP source; simulated data is labeled and never becomes a real measurement. Starlink monitoring works without an electrical sensor. Beacon features depend on compatible firmware.
The optional augmented-reality view uses public orbital data from CelesTrak. It shows predicted positions and does not confirm which satellite serves the terminal.
Core monitoring requires no Starlink account or Google Play Services. There are no ads, analytics or project cloud service. Telemetry and history stay on the device. Feature availability depends on hardware, firmware and network topology. The optional orbital catalog is downloaded over HTTPS; speed tests use the Internet connection.
Portuguese, English and Spanish text, widgets and AMOLED mode.
L-Shell Orbit is not affiliated with or endorsed by Starlink or SpaceX.

SweetKeyboard: Fast, Familiar, and Private Typing
SweetKeyboard is a local-first iOS keyboard that keeps numbers, symbols, cursor movement, and reusable clipboard snippets close to the typing flow without forcing users to learn an unfamiliar layout. Built for quick edits, codes, forms, and repeated snippets, it delivers a familiar typing experience with smarter everyday controls.
EVERYTHING YOU NEED IN ONE PLACE
• Numbers Stay Visible: The familiar English QWERTY letter layout features a permanent top number row from 1 to 0, reducing interruptions while you type codes, dates, and addresses.
• Symbols in One Place: Symbols are grouped on one clean page, designed to avoid deep symbol switching. Tap one symbol and return to letters, or lock symbols when you need to type multiple characters or emojis.
• Smarter Cursor Control: Move the cursor without fighting the iOS text magnifier using dedicated arrow keys or speed-aware horizontal swiping across the keyboard.
• Context-Aware Typing: SweetKeyboard adapts to the field you are typing in. For example, the keyboard shows a contextual @ shortcut in email fields and suppresses unwanted auto-capitalization.
• Long-Press Shortcuts: Hold supported keys for common accents and quick punctuation, keeping the main keyboard free of visual clutter.
• Fast Typing Stability: Designed for stable everyday typing, even when you move quickly and your fingers overlap.
• Forward Delete: Turn on forward delete, then use manual Shift to delete ahead of the cursor.
• Save and Reuse Snippets: Access a local clipboard grid inside the keyboard to save up to 50 local text snippets.
• Pin Favorites: Pin favorites so important snippets stay at the top of your list for quick, one-tap pasting.
• Native Clipboard Integration: Choose how SweetKeyboard handles text copied to the native iPhone Clipboard. You can import, paste, or do both after initiating a user action.
• Clear Text Field: Easily clear short fields directly from the compact keyboard toolbar.
CUSTOMIZABLE TO YOUR PREFERENCES
Your typing experience should fit your needs. Easily configure settings in the app, including optional haptic feedback for responsive keys, auto-capitalization rules, cursor swipe behaviors, and custom clipboard toolbar options.
PRIVATE BY DEFAULT, LOCAL BY DESIGN
Privacy is a central product value, not a secondary note.
• There are no analytics, no advertising SDKs, no tracking SDKs, and no cloud sync.
• SweetKeyboard features no remote text processing or keystroke uploading.
A NOTE ON CLIPBOARD FEATURES AND "FULL ACCESS"
To enable the optional clipboard features, iOS requires you to grant "Full Access". This simply gives the keyboard the necessary permissions to interact with the phone's native clipboard tools and shared local settings. This does not mean we have access to your data. Because SweetKeyboard is local by design with no cloud sync or remote processing, your typing, snippets, and clipboard history remain completely local to your device and are never compromised.
Platform Limitations: Some features depend on what the active app exposes to third-party keyboards. Secure text fields and certain apps may use the system keyboard instead. Clear Text Field works best in short fields and may be limited in long documents.

flathub:org.gnome.Genius.name: Genius
flathub:org.gnome.Genius.summary: Genius is a general purpose calculator program
flathub:org.gnome.Genius.description:
Genius is a general purpose calculator program similar in some aspects to BC, Matlab, Maple or Mathematica. 
 It is useful both as a simple calculator and as a research or educational tool. 
 The syntax is very intuitive and is designed to mimic how mathematics is usually written. 
 GEL is the name of its extension language, it stands for Genius Extension Language, clever isn't it? 
 In fact, many of the standard genius functions are written in GEL itself.
 What can it do?
 Arbitrary precision integers, multiple precision floats.
 Complex numbers, stored in Cartesian coordinates as usual.
 Math-like-looking expressions, tries to be as much a what-you-mean-is-what-Genius-understands, up to a limit of course.
 Matrix calculations / Linear Algebra, with many related functions.
 Number theory.
 Calculus, numerical and even very limited symbolic calculations.
 Statistics, all the basic statistical functions.
 Numerical equation solving, polynomial roots, etc...
 Combinatorics.
 Most common elementary / trigonometric functions.
 Modular arithmetic, including inversions and modular arithmetic on matrices.
 A complete programming language, with automatic typing. In fact large part of Genius standard library is written in GEL.
 2D Function line plots, standard 2D graphs of up to 10 functions at once, with possibility to export to EPS or PNG.
 Parametric plots, with possibility to export to EPS or PNG.
 3D Function surface plots, with possibility to export to EPS or PNG
 Slopefield/Vectorfield plotting.
 GUI IDE where you can edit and run/test your programs.
 Can output matrices in LaTeX, Troff (eqn) or MathML, this is I think a very cool feature that allows you to copy stuff directly from Genius to a document in LaTeX, troff or MathML.

firefox-addons:3089044.name: ITGlue Password Manager
firefox-addons:3089044.description:
A simple browser extension that can be used in combination with your own ITGlue environment.
Just install the add-on, once it open it will ask for Masterpassword and your ITGlue API-Key.
The API-Key must be configured by the ITGlue admin and must have "password access" enabled.
The data will be cached on your device for 10 minutes and than will be purged.
In the settings within the add-on is an option to reset your Masterpassword and setup an extension lock after 10 minutes or on browser close.
There is no need for an account within this extension. if you lost your Masterpassword, simply remove the extension and re-add to setup a new password. Remember to keep your API-Key available.
This extension uses only the get functionality of the ITGlue api and will not store or save any data on your device other then a 10 minute cache to make the extension a bit quicker with loading data.
The API-Key will be stored local but will be encrypted the moment you create the Masterpassword.
This add-on will always be free, bug reports or feature requests can be send to development@dyca-computers.nl

apple-macos:6786018687.name: Recito: Teleprompter for Video
apple-macos:6786018687.description:
Recito is a teleprompter app that records your video, on iPhone, iPad and Mac. Your script sits right under the lens, over the live camera, so you look into the camera, not down at your notes.
No account and no subscription: Recito Pro is a one-time purchase, and one purchase covers iPhone, iPad and Mac. No cloud: everything stays on your device.
THE TELEPROMPTER, DONE RIGHT
- The script sits high under the lens on a frosted, legible scrim — reading reads as eye contact.
- Adjust font size and scroll speed with a slider.
- Preview the scroll before you record to dial in your pace.
- Grab the text with your finger to scrub it mid-take.
- Mirror mode for beam-splitter teleprompter rigs.
ON IPAD TOO
- Full screen in landscape or portrait, or beside another app; readable at arm's length.
PAUSE WITHOUT LOSING THE TAKE
- Pause mid-script and the teleprompter freezes on the word you stopped at — carry on from exactly there.
- You still get ONE video. The pauses are invisible in the result.
- Fluffed a line? Delete just that part and record it again; the script rewinds with it.
RECORD AND REVIEW
- 3-2-1 countdown, then record like the stock Camera.
- Front or rear camera, portrait, with audio.
- Camera controls: tap to focus, hold for AE/AF lock, a level and a grid.
- Shoot several takes and play them back.
- A pace coach reads your delivery in words-per-minute — relaxed, great, or a touch fast.
- Keep the best take; it saves straight to Photos, ready for Reels, Shorts, or TikTok.
WORD-BY-WORD CAPTIONS (RECITO PRO)
- After a take, your script's words are timed to your own voice, on your device.
- Four styles. Auto finds your face and puts them under it when there's room; or choose top, middle or bottom.
- Lines Recito wasn't sure of are marked for you to check, and you can retype any line.
- Burned in when you save. iOS 26, in languages your device recognises on-device.
IT FOLLOWS YOUR VOICE
- Just read. The script keeps pace with you — speed up, slow down, pause to think, and the words stay where your eyes are.
- No speed to set and nothing to hold. Your hands stay free for the take.
- The word you are reading is marked, at the top of the band or in the middle, whichever you prefer.
- Recognition runs entirely on your device. Nothing is recorded, uploaded or kept — there is no account and no network involved.
- The language comes from the script itself, so there is nothing to choose. It works in the languages your device can already recognise; the app tells you plainly when yours is not one of them.
- Included free, on every script you can write for free. It starts off, so the script scrolls at the speed you set; turn it on with the Voice button when you want it.
REMOTES AND KEYBOARDS
- A Bluetooth camera remote, the volume buttons or Camera Control start and pause your take. Finish with the checkmark.
- Apple Watch (Recito Pro): start, pause and finish a take from your wrist. Finish asks first.
- With a keyboard, page turner or presentation clicker: Space starts and pauses; during a take, the arrow keys move the script.
YOUR SCRIPTS, IN ORDER
- Folders, and your own order: drag scripts where you want them, or keep the last edited on top.
- On iPad, folders and scripts sit in a sidebar beside the script you're writing, as in Notes.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- Recito collects nothing. The App Store privacy label reads "Data Not Collected."
- No analytics, no trackers, no network code outside Apple's StoreKit.
- Your scripts and videos never leave your device unless you save or share them.
ONE-TIME UNLOCK, NO SUBSCRIPTION
- Writing scripts, the teleprompter, voice-following, recording, and multiple takes are free.
- Recito Pro is a single one-time purchase: removes the watermark, allows unlimited-length scripts and adds captions and the Apple Watch remote.
- Restore it for free on any device on your Apple ID.
Questions? support@suprun.ca
